balls.text: full on fifth stump, jammed out to backward point and they jog a single.
thigh high full toss sails down the leg side for a wide, lucky not to go for five wides to the fine leg rope but a diving stop is made by Sharma.
attempted yorker zeroing in on leg stump winds up as a shin high full toss and Krunal splits his legs to flick this in Natmeg style to the fine leg rope.

full on leg stump, Pooran shuffles across to scoop over fine leg and looks like he middles this straight to the keeper taking a sharp catch diving to his right. It's somehow given not out on field. Arshdeep calls for DRS immediately gesturing to Shikhar and they go for the review. There was a clear deflection but replays show it misses the bat and flicks the pad on the way through to the keeper. However, Pooran was so far across his stumps that it flicked his pad right in front of middle stump and ball-tracking shows this ball was ripping out middle and leg stump halfway up. So the decision is overturned to out. Just not how it looked like it would have been initially.
knee high full toss on sixth stump, miscues a heave to long-off for one.
full in the slot on seventh stump. Hooda punches this high over wide long-off and finds the rope at deep extra cover.
yorker on the legs, flicked out to deep midwicket for one.

double missed runout! Short and wide, bottom edged cut eludes the keeper diving to his right but is stopped by the short third man fielder. Confusion between Hooda and Pooran about whether to take a single because Pooran wants the strike for the final over. Both men are stranded near mid-pitch. The initial throw from short third misses the striker's stumps where Hooda would have been out. Curran collects the miss mid-pitch and fires from 12 yards at the non-striker's end where Pooran would have been out by four yards but that throw misses too.
yorker on the legs, Hooda shuffles far enough across his stumps to flick this gently between fine leg and the keeper to the rope.
134 kph yorker on middle, Hooda shuffles across but can only jam this out back to Curran.
back of a length on off, Hooda goes back to tap into vacant midwicket for a jogged two.

full and angled wide on eighth stump, Stoinis shuffles across trying to paddle short arm jab flick this over fine leg but winds up top edging it swirling between the keeper and short third. The keeper calls off the ring fielder for a simple catch to end one of several fiery knocks tonight from an LSG batter.
extraordinary skill from Stoinis! Full outside leg, Stoinis backs away and spoons this inside out over mid-off clearing the ring and bounces away to the rope.
Pooran finally has his first six of the innings. Short ball on the body, rocks back to swivel and pull this high over fine leg into the second row of the crowd.
thigh high full toss on leg stump, Pooran is caught off guard and blocks it back to Rabada for a rare dot ball, that too off perhaps the worst delivery of the innings.
full outside off on fifth stump, Pooran shovels this finishing with a high elbow and times it a mile high and deep over mid-off, two bounces over the rope.
yorker on middle, flicks this out to deep midwicket for two.
full on the stumps, flicked to deep midwicket along the ground for one.
full on the legs, flicks this with exquisite timing and clears the deep backward square leg rope landing in the fifth row of seats.
full on the legs at 136 kph, flicked effortlessly splitting the keeper and short fine leg to go to the rope. 50 partnership comes up off just 23 deliveries.
full in the slot on sixth stump at 140 kph, Pooran opens up his wrists and drives this behind point beating the fielder Raza on the ring to the rope.
short on the body, goes to pull and top edges this swirling just out of the reach of the short fine leg fielder diving to his right and it lands safely for two.
yorker on middle jammed out back down the ground for one.
overpitched getting the yorker length wrong on fifth stump, Stoinis pumps this crisply through extra cover just looking for timing more than power and finds the rope.
full on the stumps, flicked out through midwicket for one.
yorker on fourth stump jammed out for none.
full on the stumps, heaves this along the ground through midwicket for one.
bouncer over the stumps. Too high and wide called.
back of a length on fourth stump, Stoinis shuffles across and misses a flick over fine leg, comes off the pads past the stumps for a leg bye. Siren goes off yet again for a no ball overstep.
full in the slot on fifth stump, Stoinis muscles a drive over mid-off sailing over the rope.
back of a length on the stumps, tap and run for one.
good length on the legs, flicked to short fine leg for a single to bring up a 31-ball half-century. Stadium is eerily quiet.
back of a length on the hips, goes to flick and misses off the pads for four leg byes to fine leg.
bouncer over fourth stump left alone.
full and tailing in towards fourth stump, miscues a drive short of mid-on and they scamper two.
length ball on middle, miscues a heave through midwicket but still has enough juice on it to find the rope.
full on off, driven past Arshdeep along the ground to long-off for one.
full on off, punched to long-off for one.
yorker speared into middle, flicked through midwicket for one.
hat-trick of fours through extra cover! Low full toss on fifth stump opens the wrists to drive inside out flat along the turf this time but picks the gap again to the same part of the boundary.
full again on seventh stump, rinse and repeat with another lofted extra cover drive to the rope.
full on seventh stump, plenty of width to attack first ball and Pooran shovels a drive flat over extra cover to the rope.

fullish length on middle, Badoni tries to repeat the slog sweep over the leg side but hits it much too flat and picks out Chahar charging in 10 yards from deep square leg to take a thigh height catch. Livingstone erupts in celebration capping off the antagonism between the two throughout the early part of the over.
full on leg stump, Badoni swats a sweep on one-knee over deep backward square leg, Chahar charges across trying to swat this back into play one-handed but it comes off his fingertips over the rope.
back of a length on sixth stump, slapped to long-off for one.
half-tracker sticks in the wicket a touch and Badoni's attempted pull winds up being finished too early and comes off the elbows into the ground.
full on seventh stump, shuffles across to sweep to deep square leg for one.
short and wide on seventh stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a fourth stump, flicked to long-on for one.

flighted full on fifth stump, charges forward and doesn't quite get to the pitch trying to drive to clear long-off, skies this to the fielder on the rope... literally. The fielder Liam Livingstone taking the catch at chest height was a bit too casual and has stepped on the rope. A wicket turns into a six. Sums up Punjab in the field.
full on fifth stump, shuffles across and sweeps this straight to short fine leg for none.

yorker outside leg stump at 132 kph, jammed out off the pads and trickles wide of leg stump for a dot. Shikhar for some reason calls for DRS.  This just shows how desperate Punjab is in the field for a wicket to stem the flow of runs. Ball pitched way outside leg stump. The players have already gone back to their marks in the field. Sure enough, ball-tracking shows this pitched outside leg. Review lost.
short and wide on eighth stump, cuts this to backward point, diving stop to knock this down but it continues to trickle away from the fielder to allow a second run to be taken.
length ball on fifth stump, sliced to Arshdeep at cover sweeper for a long single.
108 kph slower length ball on fourth stump, Stoinis not fooled and deposits a pull 25 rows back over deep midwicket. 89 meter strike clears the short boundary and then some.

slower ball back of a length on fifth stump, sliced to Arshdeep at cover sweeper for what should be a straightforward single but a terribly sloppy collection allows a second run to be taken for Stoinis to keep strike.
full on middle, Stoinis winds up for a booming drive before changing his mind halfway and checking into a defensive block back to Curran.
back of a length on fifth stump, shuffles across to tap this gently short of long-on and they scamper a sharp two.
length ball on sixth stump, sliced to the cover sweeper for one.
full on middle and leg, shuffles across to sweep this very fine to the fine leg rope.
full on leg stump, backs away to punch to extra cover for none.
full on middle, driven to extra cover for none.
back of a length on off stump, Badoni goes back to flick to long-on for one.
slower ball at 114 kph lands short on middle, just a short arm jab pull by Stoinis flicking this behind square leg and beats the boundary rider for four.
full on middle, flicked to deep midwicket for one to bring up a 50-run partnership off just 26 balls.
short outside leg at 132 kph, sits up for Badoni to front foot pull this flat over backward square leg  and screams barely over the rope. 61 meter six.
good length ball on middle and leg, tapped into midwicket for one.
good length on fourth stump, opens the wrists to try to guide this behind point and gets it very fine between the keeper and short third to the rope.
Curran starts with a slower ball on a good length on fifth stump, punched to backward point but a misfield allows a single to bring Stoinis on strike.
short on middle, pulls this to deep midwicket for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, cross bat swats this just wide of Chahar reaching out to his left at chest height and goes to long-off for one.
back of a length on middle, defended to Chahar who fields in front of the non-striker.
back of a length on middle, punched back to the bowler.
back of a length on middle, goes back to flick into square leg for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
136 kph delivery lands short on middle and leg, goes to pull and a top edge swirls over the keeper clearing the fine leg rope.
short on sixth stump, goes to pull and is beaten.
full and very wide, left alone and wide called.
length ball on seventh stump, drives square to the sweeper for one.
drool....... Fullish length on sixth stump, Stoinis times a sumptuous drive between extra cover and mid-off to the rope.
top shot! 142 kph delivery full on middle, Stoinis shuffles across to flick this over fine leg sailing into the base of the LCD ad boards.
short on fourth stump at 141 kph, pulled to deep square leg for one. The po-po are in pursuit in their squad car with the sirens blaring again. No ball once more for Gurnoor. Free hit to Stoinis.
back of a length on the hips at 139 kph, too easy to pull this off the front foot very fine to the fine leg rope.
back of a length on the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
fullish length ball on fourth stump, shoveled over the bowler and long-off is very wide so they take two.
good length ball pushed away for one.
good length ball on middle, Stoinis tries to reverse paddle this and misses it off his chest before it trickles past the keeper for a leg bye.
full on fourth stump, driven to long-off for one.

back of a length on fifth stump, just a simple punch with an open face by Badoni but places this beautifully with the wrists in a tight gap between backward point and short third man before going to the rope.

back of a length on fifth stump at 141 kph, Stoinis tries to punch this off the back foot through cover and an inside edge goes into the ground before a diving stop is made by the keeper going to his left.

back of a length back on middle at 140 kph, Mayers opts to straight bat this driving over mid-on rather than go for a pull and pays the price. He was cramped with the length being dragged back, nowhere near a drivable length and a tame shot comes off the splice floating to Shikhar five yards inside the ring at mid-on for a basic catch.
140 kph bouncer over Mayers, sails way too high and a wide is called on height.
short on fourth stump at 144 kph, goes to uppercut this over the keeper and misses.
back of a length on fourth stump at 139 kph, Mayers goes for another leg side heave and misses.
short on the body, Mayers cramped for room going to pull and a top edge swirls over the keeper to the fine leg rope.

Mayers charges a 139 kph delivery to convert this into a shin high full toss shoveling this over mid-on clearing the rope to bring up a 20-ball half-century, his fourth of this IPL campaign.  Siren goes off again. Rabada flagged for a no ball. Free hit for Mayers.
back of a length outside leg stump on the hips at 145 kph, defended back to Rabada.
full on the legs, prods this into midwicket for a single to keep the strike.
full in the slot on middle, Mayers winds up and drives this flat over long-on again thudding into the LCD ad boards.
short on middle, goes back to pull this very square to beat Sam Curran running to his left from deep midwicket and find the square leg rope.
good length on fourth stump, goes back to defend.
drag down on fifth stump, Mayers rocks back and muscles a cross bat shot sailing into the front row over long-on.
back of a length on off, defended to the off side.
bouncer on fourth stump at 145 kph, beats Badoni going to pull.
full on middle at 143 kph, whipped with plenty of wrists involved to clip this high over midwicket to the rope.
back of a length on off, defended again.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to point for none.

clever from Rabada! Sends this down a touch wider on seventh stump and drags the length back a fraction on a fullish length to tease Rahul into another drive, but there's no footwork playing well away from his body and a thick edge flies to Shahrukh who is standing at a floating wide slip/gully (or a very fine short third, depending on your perspective) position and catches this reaching to his left at shoulder height.

what a shot! 138 kph delivery full in the slot on fifth stump, KL Rahul just punches this with a high elbow finish and times the dickens out of it sailing over the long-off rope thudding into the LCD ad boards.
full on middle and leg stump at 137 kph, checked drive floats just short of Gurnoor in his follow-through and is scooped up one-handed on a short hop.

back of a length on fourth stump, another massive heave over midwicket, not timed as well this time and lands short of the rope before dribbling into it to beat Shikhar chasing in vain running to his left from mid-on.
full and wide yorker, Mayers tries to stab this out but misses.
full in the slot, Mayers slaughters this delivery a mile high before landing in the sixth row over midwicket.

back of a length on off, defended into the off side. Police siren is going off. Misdemeanor committed by Gurnoor. The umpires opt to not slap any handcuffs on him, but do penalize him with a no ball and a free hit to come for Mayers.
back of a length on off, tap and run into the covers for a tight single.
full on the legs at 140 kph, flicked easily to the fine leg rope.
attempted slower ball at 118 kph lands too full on off, Mayers isn't fooled and drives this along the ground back down the pitch past Arshdeep to the mid-off rope again.

full on fourth stump at 140 kph, Mayers smokes a drive that fizzes just above Arshdeep's head in his follow-through as the bowler turtles his head out of the way for safety before the ball goes to the mid-off rope.
full on fifth stump, huge drive results in an inside edge dribbling to midwicket for none.
full on middle at 136 kph, driven to mid-on for one.
back of a length on middle, Mayers carts this 134 kph delivery high over midwicket, one bounce over the rope.
bouncer over leg stump, Mayers leaves it be and wide is called on height from the square leg umpire.
length ball on seventh stump swinging away at 135 kph, Mayers caresses a drive on the up through backward point and it beats deep third man Chahar trying to dive across the rope.
full into middle and off, goes to flick to midwicket, leading edge skids along the ground to Taide at backward point for none.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended on the back foot to extra cover.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to the off side.
good length ball on fourth stump defended.
good length ball on fifth stump, goes to punch and an inside edge goes behind square leg for one.

dropped first ball at backward point! Regulation chance! Fullish length on fifth stump, loose drive flies to Atharva Taide's left at chest height. He reaches across his body and shells it clumsily. It was 5/10 on difficulty. Came at a firm but not fast pace by any means. Comfortable catching height. Taide got his hands in an awkward position though reaching with his arms coming with his hands up from under his ribs rather than getting his hands and shoulders over the ball.

knee high full toss on the legs at 137 kph, Shahrukh tries to heave this over the leg side rope but picks out the fielder at deep midwicket who settles under this three yards inside the rope for a basic catch at chest height to seal a 56-run win.
bouncer over leg stump, goes to pull but misses.
attempted yorker on leg stump is a low full toss flick to deep backward square leg for one, but the relay in is fumbled by Pooran to allow Shahrukh to come back for two and keep the strike.
short ball on the legs, gets inside the line to pull this to deep fine leg and they turn down a single to stay on the team 199.
full on middle, driven back to Yash Thakur for none.
full on the stumps, flicked in the air to wide long-on, fielder on a bounce tumbling to stop this by Bishnoi who keeps it to two.
back of a length on fourth stump, Arshdeep waves past this ball fooled by the lack of pace.
bullseye! Slower ball at 107 kph lands full on middle, Rabada is through a drive very early and middle stump is struck two-thirds of the way up knocking it out of the ground.
full and wide, driven to long-off and this time they opt to take a single to put Rabada on strike.
slower ball lands full and wide, drives this high over extra cover, Sams covers 25 yards running to his right along the rope from cover sweeper and dives to save two runs.
yorker outside the wide guideline, left alone and wide called.
full on the wide guideline, slapped to mid-off. Shahrukh turns down the single to protect Rabada now in at the non-striker's end following the wicket off the last ball of the previous over.
139 kph full on fourth stump, shuffles across to heave this to the leg side and picks out the long-on fielder 10 yards inside the rope for a simple waist height catch.
yorker speared outside leg stump past Chahar shuffling across his stumps, wide called.

knee high full toss outside leg, Jitesh shuffles outside leg trying to create room to drive inside out but picks out mid-off on the ring at head height. KL Rahul takes the catch after doing a little bunny hop to get his hands and head in line with the ball.
135 kph yorker outside leg stump, flicked to deep fine leg for one.
full outside leg stump, Jitesh backs away to create room and drives to long-on along the ground for one.
length ball on sixth stump, slams this flat over wide long-on and lands 10 rows back above the team dugouts.
knee high full toss on the legs, Jitesh flicks this high over deep backward square leg into the front row of the stands.
slower ball lands full on middle, Curran checks a drive fooled by the lack of pace at 107 kph and the ball balloons over extra cover. Simple catch for Badoni taken crouching down at thigh height.
slower bouncer follows Curran backing away from leg stump and he misses out on another uppercut.
head high no ball on off stump, Curran ducks under this and manages to get his bat up to flick this over the keeper for four. No ball on height and a free hit to come.
slower ball lands back of a length on fifth stump, pulled to wide long-on for two.
full on fifth stump, Jitesh shuffles way outside off stump then clears the front leg trying to heave for midwicket and misses off the legs before the ball caroms away for an extra.
full and way outside the off stump guideline, but Jitesh drives at this over extra cover to pick up another two.
full and wide, driven through wide extra cover, great effort by the cover sweeper to save two runs in a match that is long gone.
full on the legs, heaves this through the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket to the rope.
full on middle, driven to long-on for one. Siren goes off. Bishnoi has overstepped. Free hit to come.
good length ball outside leg stump, shuffles across and heaves to deep midwicket for one.
charges a full ball speared into the legs and misses a heave off the pads for a leg bye.
length ball on sixth stump, heaves this high and deep over wide long-on and just like Curran, Jitesh gets off the mark first-ball with a six.

full on the stumps, Livingstone misses a slog and a huge lbw shout is upheld. Livingstone calls for DRS but simply because they've got two reviews left and only 28 balls left in the chase. This one is stone dead hitting him on the back leg in front of middle and off. Ball-tracking shows this ripping out the middle of middle stump. If the review was called for in a different context with the match still very much alive, it would go down as one of the worst reviews of all time. Regardless, it is still a shockingly bad review for a ball so obviously out.
good length ball skids into the legs, Livingstone charges and heaves for midwicket but misses off the body.
fullish length ball outside off, driven to the sweeper for one.

dropped! Full and wide, Livingstone drives a laser to backward point and Bishnoi flings himself to his right on the ring at backward point for a chest height chance. He has it initially but the ball bounces out of his hands when his elbows hit the ground on the landing. Would've been a 10/10 catch on difficulty had it stuck because of the speed it came off the bat.
short on fourth stump, Livingstone pulverizes a pull 20 rows back over midwicket.
yorker on fifth stump, jammed out to wide long-off for two.
yorker on fifth stump, shuffles across and jams this out into midwicket for one.
good length ball on leg stump, shuffles across and flicks to deep backward square leg for one.
full on the wide guideline again, this time scuffs a lofted drive well short of long-off landing for one.
full and slanted outside the wide guideline, left alone and wide called.
full on off, jammed out back to Krunal.
full on the stumps, winds up and clocks a drive 25 rows back over wide long-on. 96 meters. Not a bad way to hit your first ball.
good length ball flicked away for one.
low full toss and wide, Livingstone comes down the track and slices a drive behind point to the rope.
full on the stumps, punched away straight to a fielder for a dot.

full on fifth stump, goes to sweep this and top edges it straight up over the pitch. Bishnoi backpedals into short mid-on and gets his body and hands into an awkward position before adjusting to get two hands around it while tumbling backwards. Bishnoi's body was in a total tangle and made that catch far tougher than it should have been but made up for it with his hand-eye coordination and athleticism.
full outside off, driven to long-off along the ground for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, slices a cut shot that beats backward point and goes to the rope.
full outside leg, goes to sweep and top edges this wide of deep backward square leg for one.
full on fifth stump, slams a drive back down the pitch, Bishnoi gets his right hand to it to knock this down and keep it to one off a carom to mid-on.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to the leg side for two.
full on leg stump, Atharva shuffles across and scoops this over fine leg, one bounce over the rope.
146 kph short ball on middle, leans back to uppercut this over the wk and goes to the rope at a very fine third man.
140 kph knee high full toss on the stumps, heaved to deep midwicket for one.

126 kph delivery lands short and wide, slaps this high but not deep enough and Krunal is in place at point sweeper taking this safely at chest height two yards inside the rope. Carbon copy dismissal to how Shikhar fell earlier except Raza is right-handed.
low full toss on sixth stump, slapped to long-on for one.

back of a length on fifth stump, shuffles across trying to scoop this over the keeper and miscues it to short third for one, but a throw at the stumps is wide and there's no backup fielder in place so they alertly scamper back for two.

good length ball on off, Raza winds up and puts all his might into pulling this over wide midwicket, it barely clears the fielder leaping up over the rope before bouncing into the tarp laid out in front of the LCD ad boards.
length ball on the stumps, wild heave comes off the inner half of the bat and skids behind square leg to the rope.
good length ball on off, muscles a pull over the bowler, long-on runs across to stop it for two.
good length ball on eighth stump, Raza falls over trying to whip this into the leg side. Appeal for stumping.
fullish length ball on fifth stump, skews a heave into the leg side for one.
good length ball, miscues this back down the pitch for none.
yorker on off, flicked out to deep midwicket for one.
length ball on fifth stump, pulled through wide long-on for two.
full on leg stump, goes to flick this away but misses off the pads before a carom goes to short third for one.
short ball on seventh stump, goes to reverse scoop this over the keeper but misses.
short on fourth stump, pulled in the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on to the rope.
short on the legs, pulled to short fine leg for one to bring up a 26-ball half-century that gets tepid reaction from the fans with this match spiraling way out of reach.
googly is a good length ball on seventh stump, shuffles across to pull through midwicket for one.
full on middle, charges and flicks through midwicket for one.
full on fifth stump, goes to sweep orthodox and drags a bottom edge to short fine leg for one.
full on leg stump, winds up a premeditated reverse sweep and connects sweetly high and deep over deep third man, one bounce over the rope.
googly flighted full on fourth stump, beats a drive spinning away past the outside edge.
good length ball on fourth stump, guided behind point for one.
full on middle, flicked out to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball skidding into the legs, jammed out by Raza for none back to the bowler.
full on fourth stump, Raza winds up and clubs this straight again through long-on, diving stop gets part of the ball but not all of it and it trickles into the rope.
full on middle, driven to long-off for one.
short on the wide guideline, goes to cut and hits it straight to backward point fielded on a bounce.
good length skids across sixth stump, goes to cut and misses.
full on off stump, Raza gets on a knee and winds up to slam this very straight to the long-on rope.
short and wide, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
flighted full on fourth stump, Atharva charges and launches a drive high and deep 20 rows back over long-on.
full on the stumps, punched to long-off for one.
full on middle and leg, sweeps this behind square leg for one.
full on off, flicked through wide midwicket for two.
short on the hips, pulled wide of deep fine leg for two.
back of a length on off, goes back to flick into vacant midwicket for two.
short on the body, pulled to deep square leg for one.
slower bouncer short ball on fifth stump at 106 kph, left alone.
short on the legs, shuffles across to pull fine to short fine leg for a quick single.
135 kph full in the slot on sixth stump, punches this in the air toward the cover sweeper, tumbling stop by Krunal keeps this to two.
135 kph length on seventh stump, Atharva slaps this in front of point and it sizzles to the rope.
full on eighth stump, drives through wide mid-off and beats the boundary rider.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched into the covers for one.
134 kph delivery lands full on fifth stump, flicked short of mid-on and they sprint a tight single to beat a direct hit into the non-striker's stumps.
length ball on fifth stump, heaves this on the up over midwicket, the boundary rider Ravi Bishnoi charges across and dives over the ball to allow it to the rope.
short on the legs, pulled to deep backward square leg straight to a fielder for what's would be a single but the ball is fumbled badly to allow a second.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to backward point.
back of a length on the hips, defended to midwicket for one.
length ball on middle at 133 kph, whips a pull straight to the sub Daniel Sams at deep backward square leg. Picks him out 12 yards inside the rope taking this simply at chest height.
full on eighth stump, slams a drive straight to extra cover for none. Prabhsimran has broken his bat in the process of playing the shot and needs a replacement so there's a short delay.
good length ball on fifth stump, sliced behind point to the deep third rope.
full on fifth stump, jammed out into mid-on for one.
good length ball slanted across fourth stump, sliced to backward point for none.
full on off stump, miscues a drive past Stoinis who gets a deflection and it dribbles to mid-on for one. Stoinis is on his knees in agony clutching at his left hand.
132 kph delivery full on fifth stump, pumps a drive through mid-off to the rope.
118 kph delivery full and angled well down leg, another wide called.
good length slower ball down the leg side again at 112 kph, wide called.
short and wide, laces this flat over point, one bounce over the rope. Krunal was there for Shikhar batting for a catch but is no longer out there with Taide now in the middle.
back of a length outside leg stump, down the leg side and left alone again, wide called.
slower ball down the leg side at 108 kph past a flick, wide called.
back of a length on the stumps, defended.

terrible misjudgment at deep backward square leg! Short ball trap was set and Stoinis bangs this in on the body at 136 kph, pulled towards the man out there but he charges in only for it to go over his head landing two yards over the rope. If he'd stayed on the rope, it would have been a head height chance.  Stoinis is shaking his head in frustration.
full and wide, driven to extra cover for none.
good length ball defended.
full on seventh stump, driven to mid-off for none.

back of a length on the hips, goes to flick and a big deflection is taken down the leg side by Pooran. Huge appeal for caught behind is denied. They've already burned a review and don't want to risk another.
